items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: I think at the time, Vic Gaspar was playing his drummer for him.

ctx.x: Actually, he looks maybe something like Louis Dumaine to me, though.
I think at the time, Vic Gaspar was playing his drummer for him.
Vic would be one of the two trombones. This is a wonderful trombone.
